newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pfizer long-term upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pfizer long-term upped.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Steve Tighe said he upgraded his long-tem rating on Pfizer Inc to buy from accumulate, maintaining his near-term rating of accumulate.
-- said raised five-year earnings growth rate to 18 percent from 15 percent.
-- said upgrade based on prospects for Viagra drug to treat male erectile dysfunction, a larger market than previously thought.
-- said expects Pfizer to file a New Drug Application for Viagra in the second half of 1997.
-- kept 1997 earnings estmate at $3.49 a share, compared with $2.99 in 1996.
